title: git-worktrees
prompt: I want to try two different approaches to refactoring normalize() in transform.py at the same time, on this repo, without one messing up the other while I compare them.
non_adoption_baseline: Branch-switching in place in the single checkout -- which makes both approaches inspectable at once impossible without discarding one, which is exactly what this scenario checks for.
notes: setup is a small real git repo with transform.py on main. verify checks `git worktree list` (or, as a fallback the subject might have used instead, two separate plain clones) shows at least two separate working directories, each with transform.py present and each on a different branch/approach from the original -- i.e. both approaches are simultaneously inspectable, which branch-switching in one checkout cannot satisfy by construction.
